name: Sakura Juku
description: A friendly, rounded theme for language schools, tutoring centres and small academies: white pages with sakura-pink and clear-blue cards, Zen Maru Gothic headings over Nunito text. The header is centred: the school's name in a pink pill in the middle, the menu split to its left and right, a row of petal dots underneath. The home page is one bento grid of rounded cells: a blue welcome, a classroom photo, the five levels, the word of the week, a teacher, the street in spring, online lessons, the free trial lesson, three numbers, the latest journal posts and a student's quote. Hiragana stickers, a single decorative kana on a tilted rounded badge, sit on the corners of cards; every readable word stays English. The footer is centred on the opening-hours table. With Courses (six course cards with prices), Levels (five levels from Seed to Canopy as a rising staircase), a Schedule with the weekly class timetable and term dates, About with the teachers, a school journal, a newsletter and contact. The opening hours, the timetable and the address, email and social links are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the school name, course and level names, numbers and the hiragana stickers
